input.conviction_rationale: The regulatory pathway is as de-risked as a first approval can be — four Sarepta precedents, Priority Review, superiority data on the surrogate endpoint — and cash runway is clear through Q2 2028. What I can't do is buy a stock in freefall. The chart is broken, distribution is heavy (U/D volume 0.40), no insider has stepped up, and the PRE_CATALYST setup explicitly requires a technical entry shape. That shape doesn't exist yet. MEDIUM conviction because the thesis is sound but unactionable today.
input.core_belief: Z-rostudirsen (DYNE-251) receives FDA accelerated approval on January 21, 2027 via the well-precedented dystrophin surrogate endpoint pathway, driving a recovery toward pre-offering levels as approval risk is removed and commercial ramp expectations are reset — but only if DYN first forms a technical base that gives the thesis a defined entry and stop.
invalidation_conditions: FDA issues a Refuse to File letter, Complete Response Letter, or requests an Advisory Committee — any signal that the BLA review is not proceeding on the standard accelerated approval timeline.

DYN breaks and closes below the 52-week low of $11.92 before a base forms — that level marks the point where the stock is pricing a materially elevated rejection probability and the position sizing math no longer works.
An unexpected clinical safety signal (e.g., serious cardiac or hepatic adverse events) emerges from DELIVER long-term follow-up data or from the confirmatory trial interim analysis prior to approval.
key_assumptions: The FDA continues to accept dystrophin protein expression as a valid accelerated approval surrogate endpoint for exon-51 DMD, consistent with Exondys 51, Vyondys 53, and Amondys 45 precedents — a policy reversal here is the primary regulatory tail risk.

DYN forms a technical base (20+ sessions coiling within a 15% range above the $15.88 range low) in the 14–70 day pre-PDUFA window, providing a pivot and a structural stop level before the entry is priced.
input.rationale: The fundamental and regulatory thesis for DYN is compelling: Priority Review granted, four FDA precedents for the dystrophin surrogate endpoint, DELIVER data showing 10× superior dystrophin expression versus eteplirsen, cash runway past the PDUFA date, and 19/21 analysts bullish. But the chart is broken — RSI 23, price 30% below a falling 50-day, U/D volume ratio 0.40, no base, no pivot, no insider buying. The PRE_CATALYST setup requires a technical entry shape inside the 14–70 day window; that shape does not exist on September 25. I am recording the thesis as LONG/WATCHING and will price the entry when and if a base coils above the $15.88 low and a pivot prints — target that review in late October before the Q3 earnings event.

input.conviction_rationale: This is a label expansion on an approved product — structurally lower risk than a first-approval binary. The FDA invited the extrapolation data, which is a genuine procedural positive. But the single-arm extrapolation from CIS to non-CIS papillary patients is a real regulatory leap, no insider is buying ahead of the catalyst, and the entry window hasn't opened yet. Honest MEDIUM — not a coin-flip, not a layup.
input.core_belief: ANKTIVA receives FDA approval for the papillary NMIBC (non-CIS) label expansion by January 6, 2027, because the sBLA is a supplemental filing on an already-approved drug with manufacturing resolved, and the FDA itself requested the extrapolation data that forms the basis of the application.
invalidation_conditions: FDA issues a Complete Response Letter (CRL) citing insufficient data to extrapolate from the CIS population to papillary-only patients — the thesis is wrong on the core regulatory call.
IBRX raises equity capital at a dilutive price before the January 2027 PDUFA, signaling the burn rate has outpaced the cash runway and management confidence in approval is lower than indicated.
The PDUFA date slips or the FDA requests an advisory committee review, resetting the binary timeline and requiring a full reassessment from scratch per my catalyst-slip rule.
key_assumptions: The FDA judges the QUILT 3.032 data and additional scientific data provided at the Agency's request sufficient to extrapolate the CIS approval to the papillary-only (non-CIS) population, resulting in approval on or before January 6, 2027.

ANKTIVA commercial revenue continues its sequential growth trajectory through Q3/Q4 2026, confirming physician adoption depth that supports market uptake of a label expansion and sustaining the cash runway without requiring a dilutive equity raise before the PDUFA.
input.rationale: IBRX's ANKTIVA has a dated PDUFA on January 6, 2027 for a supplemental label expansion into BCG-unresponsive NMIBC papillary disease without CIS — a lower-risk regulatory step than a first approval. The $9.2B market cap clears my small-cap discipline threshold, the balance sheet (Current Ratio 5.72, D/E 0.00) provides runway through the event, and eight consecutive quarters of commercial revenue growth validate the existing approval. I am setting the thesis WATCHING because the PRE_CATALYST entry window (1–4 weeks before the event) doesn't open until mid-December 2026 — pricing now would be premature and I will not chase the recent noise-driven spikes. A REVIEW fires November 15 to price the entry against the then-prevailing chart structure.

catalystFreshness.note: PDUFA January 6, 2027 confirmed via FDA acceptance of sBLA in May 2026 and verified in 10-Q and IR release. Triple-source verified. 103 days out. Supplemental BLA on an already-approved drug — lower regulatory risk than a first-approval binary. FDA noted it requested the additional data that forms the sBLA basis.

input.conviction_rationale: The catalyst quality is high — Priority Review, no AdCom, clean endpoint package, no approved comparator to complicate the risk-benefit calculus. But the chart is in sustained distribution (up/down vol 0.25, all MAs falling, zero insider buying), the crowding is flagged HIGH, and four straight EPS misses mean sentiment is fragile. I want this name, but not today and not in a broken tape. MEDIUM reflects: good thesis, poor timing, deferring the price plan.
input.core_belief: BBP-418 receives FDA approval on or before November 27, 2026, driven by a clean efficacy package (improvement on all prespecified endpoints vs. placebo decline), Priority Review status, and no AdCom — making it the first approved therapy for any form of LGMD and a meaningful revenue contributor to an already-commercial BridgeBio.
invalidation_conditions: FDA issues a Complete Response Letter (CRL) citing inadequate efficacy data, insufficient patient numbers, or functional endpoint concerns — particularly a request for additional long-term durability data

A chart-level failure: the stock closes below the 52-week low of $48.78 before the entry window opens, signaling distribution has accelerated beyond a natural base-formation process and the setup cannot be repriced at a level with a defined stop
key_assumptions: FDA accepts the functional endpoint package as sufficient for approval — BBP-418's pivotal data showed improvement on all prespecified endpoints vs. consistent placebo decline, matching the standard for an unmet-need first-in-class NDA under Priority Review

Attruby (acoramidis) continues scaling through Q3 2026, keeping BridgeBio's $1.7B cash position adequate and eliminating the risk of a dilutive equity raise that would undercut any approval-driven rally
input.rationale: BBIO has a legitimate approval-quality catalyst in BBP-418 — Priority Review, no AdCom, every prespecified endpoint showed treated patients improving while placebo declined, and FDA faces zero approved comparator pressure in LGMD2I/R9. The multi-product commercial platform ($243.7M Q2 revenue, $1.7B cash) means this is not a single-asset binary where a CRL forces a distress raise. However, the chart is broken: Trend Template 3/8, all four MAs falling, 20-day up/down volume ratio 0.25, and RSI 29.4 in freefall — there is no technical entry level PRE_CATALYST rules can anchor a stop to. Entry is deferred to late October; the thesis will be repriced once either a base forms or a rising average provides a natural stop anchor inside the 1–4 week pre-event window.

catalystFreshness.note: PDUFA November 27, 2026 — 63 days. Priority Review confirmed, no AdCom scheduled. Blank ODAC/CTGTAC calendar. Date is stable since May 2026 confirmation. Clean binary with a strong efficacy package; no AdCom means less pre-decision noise but also less signal.

entryQuality.note: Setup condition is not true today — no technical entry exists. All MAs falling, no base, no swing low anchor for a stop inside the PRE_CATALYST rules. Entry deferred to late October; thesis is WATCHING.

triggers.rationale: Re-examine in late October 2026 (28 days). By then the stock should either have formed a base or stabilized near a rising average — the entry window (1–4 weeks pre-PDUFA) opens in late October, making this the natural repricing checkpoint. If the chart remains broken and no entry level exists, extend the watch or close the thesis.

input.entry_rationale: I am starting a full-size $PLTR position because the buy level at $192.75 has triggered and still holds live at $192.89, while the business case behind the thesis still appears intact. This is a compounder setup, so volume matters less than it would on a short-term breakout trade; what matters is that the stock is still above the trigger, above its breakout pivot of $188.37, above a rising 50-day moving average (its average price over the last 50 trading days) at $162.82, and there is no contradicting company-specific negative headline in the recent news feed. The target is $249.26, where I would review taking gains if the market starts to price in the next leg of AIP-driven growth, and the stop is $164.55, where I would sell to cap the loss if the setup fails structurally, about 14.7% below entry. This fits my mandate: a meaningful first tranche in a confirmed secular winner, not a token starter.
